new.title: New chat
new.no_agents: — no agent has the Chat stage —
new.hint_no_agents: No agent has the Chat stage. Add it to one in its settings.
new.hint_no_prompt: {agent} has no prompt for the Chat stage: the chat is created, but the first message fails.
new.hint_no_llm: This workspace has no model credential for {agent}.
new.reused: @{agent} already had a chat about “{task}”. You are in that one.

menu.title: Options
menu.reset_sub: Clears the history and the agent's session

delegate.sub_off: Handles the boards' tasks on your behalf
delegate.sub_on: Acts for {person}. Click to turn it off
delegate.sub_linked: Only in a chat that is not linked to a task
delegate.disabled_by_owner: An owner turned off delegated chats in this workspace.

confirm_message.one: It will be able to create, edit and move tasks on every board in this workspace. The audit log records it as the agent, delegated by you. It cannot decide approvals or resolve threads, and to delete anything it asks you to confirm here. While it is on, only you can write in this chat. It turns itself off in {count} hour.
confirm_message.other: It will be able to create, edit and move tasks on every board in this workspace. The audit log records it as the agent, delegated by you. It cannot decide approvals or resolve threads, and to delete anything it asks you to confirm here. While it is on, only you can write in this chat. It turns itself off in {count} hours.

delegate.no_write: @{agent} has no octopus-api with write on the Chat stage: even with this on, it cannot touch the boards.

actions.forbidden: Could not: your role does not allow this.
actions.forbidden_task: Your role does not allow deleting this task (it takes admin).

confirm.reset_message: Clears the history and the agent's session — the next message starts from scratch.
confirm.delete_message: The whole conversation is deleted. This action cannot be undone.
confirm.archive_message: It leaves the list and stops taking messages. Find it under “Show archived” at the foot of the list, and unarchive it from there.

composer.label: Message
composer.archived_note: Archived chat. Unarchive it to write.
composer.thread_note: What you write here stays in this chat; it does not go back to the task's thread.

empty.no_chats: No conversations yet. Create a chat with an agent to discuss a task or an implementation without cluttering the comments.

errors.offline_create: Daemon offline — could not create the chat.
errors.offline_delegation: Daemon offline — could not change it.
errors.offline_send: Daemon offline — the message was not sent.
errors.busy_reset: The agent is replying — wait for it to finish.
errors.busy_send: The agent is still replying to the previous message.
errors.no_prompt: {agent} has no prompt for the Chat stage: until you add one, every message fails.

intro.task: @{agent} answers about “{task}”: it gets the task and its code, if any, and reads the rest with its tools.
intro.loose: @{agent} starts with no task or code: it knows what you write and what it reads with its tools.
intro.shared: Every member of the workspace sees this chat: @{agent} answers mentions on the task from it.
